senses.gloss: animal, esp. beast of chase, deer &c., contrad. to בְּהֵמָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 6:1">Ḥull. VI, 1</cite> <he>ונוהג בח׳ ובעוף</he> and applies to beasts of chase and birds; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:9">Ab. V, 9</cite>, a. fr. <he>ח׳ רעה</he> the plague of wild beasts.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:5">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:31">Ps. LXVIII, 31</cite>) <he>ח׳ הדרה וכ׳</he> the beast that lives between the reeds (Rome).—

<cite ref="Shabbat 151b:10">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:3">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין ח׳ רעה שולטת וכ׳</he> no wild beast has power over man, unless he appears to it to resemble a brute creature; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00690"><he>חַיּוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 8a:11">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לע״ל … כל הח׳ וכ׳</he> in the future all the wild beasts shall gather and come to the serpent &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:8">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>כלב בח׳</he> the dog (is the most irrepressible) among the wild beasts.
Ber. 61ᵇ פקח שבח׳ the shrewdest of all animals; a. v. fr.—Esp. Ḥayoth, legendary celestial creatures (Ez. I, 5).
